description: Integrate quality-focused agents (tdd-guide, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, build-error-resolver) into Ralph's implementer iteration loop with post-implementation review gates

userStories.title: Add post-implementation code-reviewer invocation
userStories.description: As the implementer agent, I want to invoke the code-reviewer agent after implementing a story so that code quality issues are caught before committing.
acceptanceCriteria: After implementation and quality checks pass (step 4), implementer invokes the code-reviewer agent via the Agent tool
Code-reviewer receives the git diff of uncommitted changes as context
Code-reviewer output (findings and verdict) is captured by the implementer
Findings are logged to progress.txt under the story's entry with a **Code Review:** section
Code-reviewer verdict does NOT block the commit (advisory only)
If the code-reviewer reports HIGH issues, implementer attempts to fix them (1 attempt) before committing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add post-implementation security-reviewer invocation
userStories.description: As the implementer agent, I want to invoke the security-reviewer agent after implementing a story so that security vulnerabilities are caught before committing.
acceptanceCriteria: After code-reviewer runs (US-001), implementer invokes the security-reviewer agent via the Agent tool
Security-reviewer receives the git diff of uncommitted changes as context
Security-reviewer output is captured by the implementer
Findings are logged to progress.txt under the story's entry with a **Security Review:** section
If security-reviewer finds CRITICAL issues: implementer MUST fix them before committing (up to 2 attempts)
If CRITICAL fixes fail after 2 attempts: story is marked blocked with blockReason including the security finding
Non-CRITICAL security findings are logged but do not block
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Auto-invoke build-error-resolver on quality check failures
userStories.description: As the implementer agent, I want to automatically delegate to build-error-resolver when build or type checks fail so that build errors are resolved more effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: When a quality check fails in step 4, the implementer invokes build-error-resolver via the Agent tool BEFORE attempting manual fixes
Build-error-resolver receives the error output and the list of changed files as context
Build-error-resolver attempts minimal fixes and re-runs the failing check
If build-error-resolver succeeds: implementer continues to step 5 (commit)
If build-error-resolver fails: implementer falls back to existing error recovery (1 remaining manual attempt)
The build-error-resolver invocation counts as one of the 2 allowed fix attempts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Invoke tdd-guide for test-first enforcement
userStories.description: As the implementer agent, I want to consult the tdd-guide agent's methodology during implementation so that tests are written before production code.
acceptanceCriteria: The implementer agent instructions reference the tdd-guide workflow (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR) in the implementation step (step 3)
When implementing a story that involves new functions or modules, the implementer writes tests first following tdd-guide patterns
The tdd-guide is NOT invoked as a separate agent call -- its methodology is embedded as instructions in the implementer's step 3
The implementer's step 3 instructions explicitly state: Write failing tests first, then implement minimal code to pass, then refactor
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update progress.txt format for agent review sections
userStories.description: As a developer reviewing Ralph's output, I want progress.txt entries to include agent review findings so I can see what was caught and fixed.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress report format in implementer.md is updated to include optional **Code Review:** and **Security Review:** sections
Each section includes: verdict (APPROVE/WARNING/BLOCK), issue count by severity, and any issues that were auto-fixed
When no issues are found, the section shows APPROVE - No issues found
The format is documented in the Progress Report Format section of implementer.md
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update implementer.md with full agent integration
userStories.description: As a developer maintaining Ralph, I want the implementer agent definition to be a single source of truth for the full iteration loop including all agent invocations.
acceptanceCriteria: implementer.md step 3 (Implement) includes TDD methodology from tdd-guide (write tests first, RED-GREEN-REFACTOR)
implementer.md step 4 (Quality Checks) documents build-error-resolver auto-invocation on failures
A new step 5 (Agent Reviews) is added between current steps 4 and 5, documenting code-reviewer and security-reviewer invocations
The step numbering is updated (old step 5 Error Recovery becomes step 6, etc.)
The Agent Reviews step clearly documents: invocation order, what context each receives, how findings affect the commit, and the security-reviewer gating behavior
All agent names referenced match the actual filenames in .claude/agents/
The updated implementer.md is self-contained
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update docs/agents-and-skills.md
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the documentation to reflect the updated implementer workflow with agent integration.
acceptanceCriteria: The implementer section in docs/agents-and-skills.md is updated to describe the new iteration loop with agent invocations
The protocol list includes the new Agent Reviews step
The document explains which agents block vs advise
The document explains the build-error-resolver auto-invocation behavior
The TDD methodology integration is mentioned
Typecheck passes
